reviews.text:
My dogs love Stephen. Eeyore watches him leave and cries a little bit every time we say goodbye.

I came to Stephen after being dragged to the ground twice while walking my big dogs, and also for their dog reactivity. Stephen has great tips to share and is always patient with my million questions. He’s also flexible and very clear in his communication. My dogs learned how to walk properly on leash very quickly, and the “place” command has also been very helpful. I was also able to use some of the techniques I learned from Stephen with some other dogs.

While my dogs are progressing more slowly with their dog reactivity, I’ve learned useful skills to keep them under control. More importantly, I’m much more confident trying to face situations where dog reactivity might happen now, whereas I used to panic. I’m looking forward to joining the free group classes, which I imagine will be really helpful for dog reactivity as well. I love that the classes are held in Central Park, where you get to “set it up” and make corrections when reactivity happens. And of course, the beautiful environment.

You would need to purchase several extra tools, and the cost varies, but Stephen also helps you work with what you already have and what you can afford.

Overall, I feel very lucky to have met Stephen. He’s experienced, genuine, humorous, and generous. We’re thankful.

Hello Horyzon Green. We take all feedback seriously, but we have no record of you as a client or of any interaction with our business. If this review was intended for another business or if you’ve used a different name, please contact us so we can investigate and address your concerns.

My dog Gizmo started training with Stephen when he was about six months old- after he had already completed a course of puppy kindergarten. Gizmo learned so many important skills during his training with Stephen but more importantly I learned training skills! I had to leave NY for a while- so I continued Gizmo’s training with different trainers and I could absolutely tell the difference! I am telling you as someone who has done two courses of puppy kindergarten, a board and train program, at home training for about 12 sessions and recently learned from professional gun dog trainers in Ireland that Stephen is the absolute real deal! As Gizmo continues to get older and recently hit the adolescent phase, you can tell that the things he’s retained are the commands that Stephen taught us.

We are very grateful to the Spot-On K9 Training program — Stephen helped us break through to some of our dog Henry’s root challenges in a clear and direct manner. This provided a pivotal change in our dog’s journey that we will keep building upon. We highly recommend Spot-On for anyone looking for the tools for both their dog and for themselves. It is also nice to work with somebody that understands the nuances of having a dog in the city. That’s you, Stephen! Thank you again!

We took our 7-month Brittany puppy to Stephen to work on leash skills and off-leash recall introducing an e-collar. Our pup, being a high-energy breed originally bred for bird hunting, has a high prey drive for birds and squirrels, and we wanted to let him off-leash to run and enjoy Central Park but were afraid that he'd run off.

Working with Stephen of Spot-On was a great experience. Our dog no longer pulls us around on walks and we also introduced "place" which has allowed us to take him to café patios, have him lie down, and be relaxed (we never thought he'd be a dog we could take with us to a patio without causing a disturbance). Finally, the off-leash recall has been excellent and we now take our dog to Central Park nearly every morning and it's a joy seeing him run and play, which also means he sleeps all day long when we get home he's so tired. We've never had an incident with him running off and have great piece of mind after Stephen trained both my wife and I in the use of the e-collar, and the dog to have strong recall.

The only challenging thing was both Stephen and my wife and I have busy schedules so it took a few months to find mutual availability and complete all 5 classes so recommend for potential clients making time on weekdays so you can get through the classes quickly. However, we got homework each class so we still had things to work on every day ahead of the next one.

Highly recommend booking for whatever your goals are with your dog!

We would totally recommend Stephen for dog training - ESPECIALLY if you are interested in gaining off leash skills. Our dog (Albie, a 1.5yr rescue) loves to play with other dogs and explore (but also likes to eat trash or whatever he finds AND can sometimes be "a lot" when trying to engage in play with other dogs) so we were really motivated to be able to train Albie to recall perfectly, leave it, heel etc so he could be independent in Central Park. Stephen's toolkit and teaching gave us the skill set to be able to have Albie off leash with 100% confidence in the morning and we all have the best time! We even sometimes will take him off (although not regulation) now during the afternoon and have him in heel next to us walking so that if no one is around we can let him so chase squirrels. his recall is perfect. he has gained a lot of home skills too, including most importantly, place training, esp as a reactive greeter when people come to the door. We are so proud of albies progress and we feels so lucky to have worked with Stephen and learned e-collar skills!

My Aussie, Margot, had bad reactivity to other  dogs to the point where she would be a danger to herself and others. We took her to spot on to work with Stephen. He taught us how to properly use a prong collar which helped immensely with her aggression! We can walk her all over with minimal reactivity. He helped us better understand and read Margot’s actions to help protect her and predict her next move!

We rescued a 2 year old French bulldog who was incredibly stubborn.  He constantly was mounting our other dog, not listening, and making our lives fairly miserable.
I contacted Stephen through the recommendation of the rescue.  He was incredibly responsive and was able to begin training quickly.
We were able to notice a difference after the first meeting with Stephen.
Our dog now is a totally different dog.  He no longer mounts our female, listens and follows basic commands (for the most part), and is much more manageable.
We were able to do all the training sessions right in our backyard making it very convenient and comfortable.  What we learned through these training sessions has been invaluable and I highly recommend using Spot-On if you’re looking for a trainer!
Amazing,  so good and effective that seemed like a miracle. It only took one session to change our puppy's behavior in walks and greeting other dogs. Stephen is amazing!

My dog Chad struggled with leash walking and recall. We worked with Stephen, and Chad quickly picked up better behaviors and skills, and he is much happier and more confident. We both enjoy our walks both on leash and off leash now!

Stephen is amazing!! I signed up for training as my 3.5-year-old baby, Enzo, had issues while walking on the leash and always wanted to be in front. He also got too excited whenever he saw another dog or a bird and would pull me towards them. After just one session, I saw such a big difference. Enzo started walking next to me and became much more obedient in general.

Each lesson had a clear target, which really helped both of us. For one of the class, we learned “place” and Enzo jumped up on a rock and held a “place” command like a pro. That was just the second lesson. He has never jumped that high before, let alone sit still at that height, so I believe his confidence grew, and so did mine too, as a dog parent. The concierge in my building even shared that they notice a difference in Enzo’s behavior!

Enzo really likes and respects Stephen, and it shows in how he responds to him. If you're thinking about getting help with your pups, I can’t recommend Stephen enough. Thank you so much, Stephen you have truly been wonderful and such a good trainer!

Before training, our Vizsla Donna was a handful—her recall was unreliable, especially around birds and squirrels, which made walks in busy Central Park stressful. Her strong hunting instinct often overrode the leash manners we tried to teach, so there was a lot of pulling on walks. We were hesitant to move beyond positive reinforcement and try stricter methods, worried it might stress Donna. Stephen helped us introduce a balanced approach that set clear boundaries without causing unnecessary stress. Donna responded really well, and the changes were noticeable .

Now, Donna listens reliably, her leash manners have improved, and we enjoy off-leash mornings together a lot. She’s happier, and our walks are much more enjoyable and relaxed.

I highly recommend Spot-On K9 Training. Stephen’s thoughtful, balanced methods made a world of difference for Donna and our family!

Stephen as amazing to work with. Our dog, Bo, has benefitted immensely from the structure of Stephen's program to teach our dog desired behavior and consequences. Stephen has a great, balanced training program that has now provided Bo with the freedom to be off leash, something that we never thought was possible.

Me and my pup Harvey had the absolute pleasure of working with Stephen. Stephen and Harvey and I had an overall focus on obedience, he showed me how to teach Harvey things like sitting on command, out, place, etc. Stephen is not just teaching your dog he is teaching you. Stephen met Harvey and me when Harvey was about 4 months old, Harvey and me finished his training in about two months, Harvey is now a year and 2 months old and everywhere i go I've received compliments on his temperament, his ability to execute commands quickly and confidently and how patient he is, Harvey has just been called an all around good boy. Stephen has helped me turn my dog into his best self. Stephen Doesn't just do training with your dog he is training you to train your dog and teaching you a life skill you just have to put in the effort, Stephen will be with you every step of the way be it through emails or the resources he gives out links to the best supplies and weekly informational guidebooks about dogs and the training you are working on with him. I'm no trainer but i have taught many  a friends dog some new tricks thanks to my training with Harvey and Stephen and resources Stephen gave me. disclaimer Stephen training does not make you a dog trainer he gives you the ability to train your dog. Stephen taught me how to build a strong relationship between me, Harvey, and my 3 cats that also really worked out because before i met Stephen they were relentlessly trying to terrorize the pup now i can leave them to hang out with each other for hours. Stephen is truly the Best of the Best.

I have a lovely and anxious Jindo rescue. I reached out to Stephen because I wanted to further build up her confidence and help her reach her full potential. Stephen helped me better understand how to communicate with my dog through leash training, leadership through concise verbal commands, and positive body language. Stephen himself was also great at building rapport with my girl who is very wary of people in general. He knew exactly how to approach her. She was already building trust with him by the second session. I highly recommend Stephen for those looking for structured guidance and definitive results for dog training.

We brought Governor in as a puppy and had immediate success learning obedience and training with Stephen. Within one session Governor was no longer pulling when we walked, his obedience improved, and it was like night and day. We will continue to use K-9 training and highly recommend it to others!

I can’t thank Stephen enough for his help in training Milo for off-leash with e-collar.
I’d been through a couple of training programs before but the balanced approach that Stephen uses provided the discipline needed to get Milo to that next level.
Before training with Stephen, I was having a really hard time walking him (lots of pulling) and going off leash became impossible after several incidents in the park (including ball stealing (and eating), darting out in front of a moving vehicle and eating a plastic bag filled with something I couldn’t see). In just a short time working with Stephen, the results were almost instantaneous and continued to grow with time. Spending time training has deepened our bond and made walks more fun and it’s so rewarding now to be able to go to the park and watch him play knowing I can trust him to listen to me.

My puppy, Laika, tries to play with every single dog he encounters.  Although he comes when called in private, if there is another dog around he would not even acknowledge my calls.  And I've had several dog walkers quit because his pulling on the leash whenever he sees another dog makes them nervous.

The change after Spot-On is unbelievable.  He is a joy to walk now and the recall is so much better he spent the entire 5th session off leash in Central Park (pics attached).  I have never seen Laika as happy as he was running free in the park.  I cannot recommend Stephen enough.

I can't recommend this trainer enough!! I would recommend his work to anyone with any breed, any behavioral issue hands down. For context, I adopted a shepherd mix (Olivia) in October 2024, a couple months after my heart dog passed. Olivia reminded me so much of my previous dog, who would have likely ended up in a shelter with behavioral issues if I hadn't adopted her as a puppy. She was also reactive so I've had 12 years of experience handling reactivity, resource guarding, loads and loads of training (worked with two trainers in California).

But when I adopted Olivia, she came heavily medicated from the shelter (800mg of gabapentin and 300mg trazodone daily). Even with that, her leash reactivity was off the charts. She went from a sweet little golden to an insane Cujo and I wish I were exaggerating. It was scary, I seriously thought she was going to bite a dog and was starting to feel incredibly overwhelmed and fully in over my head. This felt more like aggression rather than just reactivity. I called at least 10 trainers, many quoting me various prices/promises and nothing sounded right. When I called Stephen, he spent over 30 minutes with me getting a full understanding on what was going. She'd been found roaming the streets after an altercation with another dog, so that made things a little more complicated. But leaving the call I felt like this was different. He was kind, validating, and overall so supportive and humble. We scheduled a behavior modification course and started classes in January 2025. When I say I saw differences after the FIRST class, I am 1000% serious. He gave us the tools to communicate and work on her basic obedience and teach her what behaviors were acceptable and what was not. After the first class she went from reacting at every single dog she saw (lunging, growling, barking, snapping), even ones across the street, to maybe only ones that triggered her, or had startled her. At least an 80% decrease after just one hour. She learned to make better choices as I learned her body language to prevent her from loading. By the end of the 4th class Stephen said we were ready for group class, which honestly really sets him apart from every trainer I contacted. It was a safe and welcoming environment for dogs that were also reactive and helped expose them in a controlled setting. I was convinced it was going to be a disaster because she's never been around so many dogs at once. And she did phenomenally. I was utterly mindblown. After our 5th class and 2nd group class, Stephen said we were ready for the off leash final. My anxiety was through the roof but she was able to be a dog again. She encountered and played with at least 20 dogs of all sizes, breeds, energy levels, with zero reactivity. Stephen gave us our life back. I no longer walk the streets in utter fear, I am able to take her to the park and meet her needs in confidence. She went from what I was convinced was an aggressive dog I would have to move to the country for, to a sweetheart neutral pup that loves to play and make new friends. I am beyond grateful for the work Stephen put in, the tools/communication he gave us, and the genuinely safe and kind environment he created for us. 15/10 recommend to everyone.

Oh and Olivia LOVES him. She whined every time we we ended classes and walked away, and she still looks for him at the park. We will be continuing group classes every month without question.

It was an absolute pleasure working with Stephen. Our dog Niko, struggled with dog reactivity and re-call so we signed him up for the off leash e-collar training.

I can confidently say that without a doubt, Niko's behavior has vastly improved as well as our relationship with our dog. We now have full confidence in Niko's off-leash recall with the e-collar and are thrilled to give him the freedom he deserves. Could not recommend this trainer enough!

I had the opportunity to work with Stephen for one of the smartest dogs I've ever had, Stryker, a 3 year-old Dutch Shepherd.  Stryker's biggest issues were reactivity towards other dogs, especially on leash.  Through 5 sessions, Stryker was not only able to put into place all of his obedience training, but was able to work around any 4 legged distraction, be it dogs, squirrels, horses, etc.  Our graduation session was Stryker being able to happily interact with dogs throughout Central Park.  The training is a game changer for Stryker and we want to thank Stephen for his training.

I had the pleasure of working with Stephen to train my dog for off-leash recall, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the results! Stephen was incredibly knowledgeable and tailored the training to my dog’s specific needs, which made all the difference. He took the time to understand her behavior and adjusted the approach accordingly. My dog's recall has improved drastically, and it’s clear that Stephen is passionate about what he does. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for a professional, effective dog trainer who truly understands dogs! Thank you, Stephen!

We had a great experience working with Stephen training our GSD puppy. Our puppy was on the more shy timid side. While teaching him basic commands and proper leash walking Stephen also gave us strategies to increase his confidence to make our puppy into a more confident young adult. All of his strategies are easily followed at home and our puppy quickly picked up on everything he was learning. After each session Stephen sends follow up emails with resources and links for anything you learned in the session. Stephen was always there to answer any questions and also increased our confidence as new dog owners. We look forward to using Stephen again in the future and would recommend to all our family and friends.

Stephen is great to work with. My main concern was an anxious dog who wanted to lead our walks – from the first lesson, our walks completely changed. It's made SUCH a difference in the day-to-day with my pup. More than anything, I feel like Stephen equipped me with the tools to be able to communicate with my dog – I know these skills will continue to help me in the future. I would definitely recommend Spot-On to anyone looking to better their working relationship with their dog!

Stephen is a phenomenal trainer. The results with our dog, Cicero, were very rapid. Stephen has a very patient and direct approach that makes at home training in between sessions very clear. He also has a very dog friendly energy cause our dog was wagging his tail by training session 2 to see him. Very importantly, Stephen set us tasks/homework that accelerated Cicero’s training. We went to Stephen because Cicero lunged at people when he got nervous or over protective. With a few exercises and encouragement to be consistent in training, the lunging ceased. Each session with Stephen was fun and efficient and the results in Cicero’s behaviour are clear to see. 5 star all round.

Stephen has been the most amazing trainer for my pup! She came to him with behavioral issues namely aggression towards other dogs and separation anxiety. Throughout the training sessions i have seen major changes in bambi and we are now able to live a much happier life! Bambi is able to walk incredibly on the leash, stay in place for up to 45 minutes and is slowly getting more comfortable around other dogs. I am so happy that we were able to make these changes as her behavior was making us question if we were a right fit for her and her needs. Bambi went from a scared and shy dog to a much more confident puppy! Thank you so much Stephen!

Brought my dog over from Brazil, and he was very reactive already but since our arrival it has gotten worse.. Than a couple of people recommended Stephen and Spot-On K9 Training and our lives changed!! My dog is less reactive, more calmer, I can control him better.. could not be thankful enough for all the training!! Stephen is incredible and it really transformed my dog and our relationship

We worked with Stephen to help improve obedience (stopping while walking, stubbornness) and recall for our energetic, 3 year old lab Suzy. When we first started training, she was ignoring cues and very selective when obeying commands around distractions (especially dogs). Upon working with Stephen, we are now confident in our ability to have Suzy off leash around distractions due to her improved recall and ability to settle. We are so excited to be able to explore new places with our dog thanks to Stephen. She also LOVED Stephen to the point that she didn’t want to leave training sessions! Thank you!

10/10 recommend Stephen as your professional dog trainer!

When I began classes for my 4 month old puppy, my puppy did not listen to commands and had a difficult time walking well on the leash. It was difficult to take her for walks since she would stop in the middle of the sidewalk and not want to walk any further, so we would have to turn back home. She also would not listen to basic commands, such as “come”, “sit”, “stay”, etc. which was frustrating as a new dog owner. I felt really lost with how to train her.

After working with Stephen over the course of 5 sessions, I can say he is the most effective dog trainer I have come across over the course of my time having dogs. Now, my puppy walks with no issues and will walk right at the heel. She can go for walks as long as 2 hours now and will remain right at my heel the entire time. Another huge point of success is that she now stays in place until I call her name to release her, which is very important for when I have guests over. Stephen also had our puppy work on off-leash training. I feel very confident in her ability to stay close to me if she is off her leash or come back when I call her name, which is especially important for when she runs around in large fields or when we go walking on trails.

Stephen was extremely attentive in each of our 5 private sessions, and he truly cares about you and your dog’s training progression. His professionalism, responsiveness, and kindness made training so seamless and made confidence-building as a trainer easy as well. Don’t hesitate to sign up for classes - using Spot-On K9 Training was the best decision for myself to learn how to approach training the right way and for my dog to build her self-esteem walking in the big city!

I contacted Stephen for private dog training after doing some online research about different classes/trainers in the area and saw all of his great reviews.

We have a 9-month old Cavapoo and started with Stephen when she was around 6-months. While not really a problematic dog by any means, she does have typical overactive puppy energy and pulled a lot during walks in all different directions.

The tools and tricks that Stephen gave us from the first lesson mostly solved her worst leash pulling issues within an hour. It's still a work in progress (as dog training always is), but it was a pretty immediate and drastic difference.

During every class, Stephen offers a lot of various tricks and methods for whatever dog issues you might be having. He understands that there is no one-training-method-fits-all when it comes to dogs, and he is very flexible and helpful when brainstorming different solutions. Post-class, he always sends a follow-up email with a TON of extra information and guides to support whatever things we worked on during the class.

I would definitely recommend Stephen if you're new to dog ownership and need someone to train your dog (and you!) on obedience and routines.

Spot-on Training with Stephen is fantastic. My dog is scared of his own shadow on the street- but after our four private sessions, we attended a group class today very successfully. Here's the thing: if you are consistent you will see RESULTS. If you put in the time you'll be paid dividends! Happy dog, happy handler.

There isn’t a better behaviorist/dog trainer in the city than Stephen! Working with Stephen was worth every penny. He’s an extremely knowledgeable, no-nonsense and to the point kind of guy. His methods are humane and fail-proof. And he caters and adjusts his training to every client and every dog to make sure that we get exactly what we need out of these sessions. You can also tell he deeply cares about and has so much respect for animals. He will also guide you throughout the process and send you extensive materials to refer back to.

My little girl has struggled with anxiety since she was little but she has gained a tremendous amount of confidence since we started working with Stephen. In truth, the training was as much for her as it was for me to become a better leader and dog parent.

I couldn’t recommend him more to anyone in the area looking to improve their relationship with their pup and resolve any issue whether outside or in the home.

We adopted a 13 month rescue dog, Bella who is 40% Husky, 30% Australian Cattle dog and 20% American Bully. She looks like a black wolf with blue/white eyes, very striking.  She needs a ton of exercise and is very independent and willful.  We signed up with Stephen and spent 6 weeks with leash and e-collar training, that have enabled us to confidently take Bella to off leash exercise in Central Park almost daily.  Stephen is easy to work with reliable and very knowledgeable.  We highly recommend him and would go with him again with further training needs.
Really enjoyed working with Stephen! My dog is a better dog because of him.

I called Spot-On K9 training at a time where I felt I had exhausted all of my options for my reactive 1 year and a half golden doodle, Cairo. Cairo is a very affectionate dog but has struggled with anxiety and reactivity towards other dogs …

Stephen is not the first trainer my husband and I have worked with however the results from working with Stephen has exceeded our expectations. Before starting SOK9T our dog Z would excessively pull on the leash and was very reactive to …

Stephen was a fantastic, patient, super helpful guide and teacher. Through Stephen's training, Seymour has become much calmer and learned how to immediately respond to important recall commands. Stephen's training has transformed our park …
